title: Breakfast Rate Banded by the Breakfast Already Standing on a Hotel Folio
content:
The breakfast rate used for the departure morning of a stay in the Hotel Rate Plans range is set by the breakfast already standing on the folio for the stay.

Where the breakfast already standing comes to 60.00 USD or more, the breakfast rate is 18.00 USD. Where it comes to 40.00 USD or more but less than 60.00 USD, the breakfast rate is 21.00 USD. Where it comes to less than 40.00 USD, the breakfast rate is the rate plan's own breakfast amount.

| Breakfast already standing on the folio | Breakfast rate |
| --- | --- |
| 60.00 USD or more | 18.00 USD |
| 40.00 USD or more but less than 60.00 USD | 21.00 USD |
| Less than 40.00 USD | The rate plan's own breakfast amount |

The figure banded here is the money total of the breakfast already standing on the folio for the stay, not the number of breakfast lines posted there.

*Both sides of each threshold, on hypothetical folios.* Breakfast already standing at 60.00 USD gives a rate of 18.00 USD; at 59.99 USD it gives 21.00 USD; at 40.00 USD it gives 21.00 USD, that figure being the foot of the middle band; at 39.99 USD it gives the rate plan's own breakfast amount.

*The bands read in order of size.* The more breakfast already stands on the folio, the lower the rate for the departure morning: 18.00 USD at the top band, 21.00 USD at the middle, and the plan's own amount below both.
